verdict.rationale: Morph's own Reflexes feature lets a user send labeled examples, train a custom text classifier (about 30 seconds), and then classify against it on the same API, so training on your own data and serving the result in place is documented. It is limited to small classifiers: nothing shows fine-tuning a selectable base model such as the open-weight chat models, and dedicated endpoints only reserve capacity for existing models. Missing for 10: fine-tuning of supported base or chat models, base-model selection, serving fine-tuned weights via chat or dedicated endpoints, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ml-engineer, I can fine-tune a supported base model on my own data and serve the result on the same platform

citations.quote: Send labeled examples, get back a text classifier. Create a job, poll until it finishes, then classify text against it.
A small Reflex trains in about 30 seconds.
